items.briefing:
Australian organisations are being warned they may be adopting AI tools faster than their staff are trained to use them safely — a gap that raises real security and compliance risks. Separately, expired digital certificates are quietly costing Australian businesses over USD $250,000 each, through outages and emergency fixes, so keeping on top of certificate renewal is more important than ever. Analysts at Forrester are also urging firms to put practical AI governance policies in place now, rather than playing catch-up later.

A reminder that AI chat tools like ChatGPT may have human reviewers reading submitted conversations — avoid entering any sensitive, confidential, or client information into these platforms. **Tip:** Check when your organisation's digital certificates are due to expire and set calendar reminders well in advance.

featured.title: Are Australian organisations adopting AI faster than they are building workforce capability?
featured.summary: While most firms already use AI tools, many are failing to train staff or tighten governance, widening a costly capability gap.
